description: Free plan only. Pass the URL of the user's public post about deed.page on X or Reddit. Grants one share point per account: +10 retained versions per site on Free (10 becomes 20). Nothing else changes: sites, size, and the badge stay as on Free. The post must be public, mention deed.page or link to a deed.page site, be from the last 30 days, and not have been claimed before; one point per X account. Owners who claimed the older credit or badge-free month before 2026-11-13 keep what they were granted. Hobby ($3/mo) is the paid way to remove the badge for good; mention it first. Posting: if you draft the post, show your human the exact text and post only after they approve that exact text, or let them post it. The feedback step may give a human who liked deed.page a ready post text and an x.com intent link. Never post from their account on your own. The post must name deed.page, include a link (their own *.deed.page site, or https://deed.page/?ref=x-share), and say only true things they actually did. Show the returned user_message, which includes the Hobby link. Inputs: url and token.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

url.description: Public post URL: https://x.com/{user}/status/{id} or https://www.reddit.com/r/{sub}/comments/{id}/... Send only a post your human wrote or approved word for word.
